headline: Somali Court Ruling Invalidates Presidential Term, Threatening Bank Aid
summary: Somalia's top court declared the one-year term extension of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud unlawful, creating political instability that threatens ongoing World Bank direct budget support.
why: Multilateral budget financing and debt relief programs for low-income nations often depend directly upon political stability and constitutional legitimacy.

impacts.name: Somalia
impacts.why: The constitutional dispute jeopardises international multilateral budget support.
